Byte-for-byte copies of her originals; not edited. Listed in integrated/protected-originals.json so the swarm loop can never overwrite them.
state-space/mesh-state-space.js, constants.js, addressing.js, claim-status.js and experiments/scale/controls.js
  from github.com/justappgrabbin/SynthAi  computer/donors/synthia58/Synthia-Solo-Hover-v0.5.8/ui/studio/src/{state-space,experiments/scale}/   (mesh-state-space.js md5 f0ca8abdb926bee5f7a80a8a5d16d0ce, identical in several of her vendor directories)
  They are the import closure of mesh-state-space.js: 5 dimension layers x 64 gate nodes, each layer ordered by its own sequence (Movement reverse, Evolution mawangdui, Being fuxi, Design kingwen, Space complement).
  The file's header states which assignments are UNCONFIRMED (Movement=reverse, Space=complement, Being chart) and that the Mawangdui family order is version-dependent; none of that is decided here.
